verdict.rationale: The firm's Lowenstein x Clerky page documents founder stock issuances and 83(b) election form generation, with a managed 83(b) add-on, and says Post-Incorporation Setup captures founder-specific vesting. These are delivered through the Clerky workflow and described only briefly, and nothing addresses how to split equity among co-founders. missing for 10: guidance on co-founder equity splits, substantive explanation of vesting schedule terms (e.g., cliffs, acceleration), in-depth 83(b) explanatory material beyond form generation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's own materials cover founder equity mechanics — vesting schedules, 83(b) elections or the local equivalent, and equity splits among co-founders — so day-zero ownership is set up right

citations.quote: founders can complete essential incorporation tasks—including adoption of bylaws, appointment of directors and officers, founder stock issuances, and generation of 83(b) election forms—using standardized, venture grade documentation.
Post-Incorporation Setup also captures founder specific vesting and IP details
a managed 83(b) election add on is available for $149.
